name: Kagurasaka Reiko
source: Leader of the Lakers. While she lives as a student, she is also active as a popular idol. She awakens as a Laker while with Akira Daidōji when Gadrum is attacked. She later becomes the lover of Akira Daidōji, but in III, she gets tired of Akira Daidōji's indecisive behavior, so she breaks up with him.
